summary: Four men travelling together in a silver car were killed in an ambush at about 3 pm on Monday, 26 October 2026, along a highway in an interior part of Barangay Tulunan, Datu Anggal Midtimbang, Maguindanao del Sur. All four died instantly from multiple gunshot wounds, and the car went into a shallow roadside ditch. Col. Michael John Mangahis, the Maguindanao del Sur police provincial director, and local officials said the victims were most likely not residents of the province; as of 4 pm they had not been identified. The Army’s 6th Infantry Division is helping police identify the victims and the attackers.

sources.title: 4 killed in Maguindanao del Sur ambush
